facts.title: Xaqiiqooyinka Quraanka
facts.sub: Xaqiiqooyinka qaab dhismeedka laga soo xigtay ee ku saabsan Quraanka.
facts.disclaimer: Xaqiiqooyinka Qur'aanka waxaa ku jira kaliya macluumaadka si toos ah looga xaqiijin karo qoraalka Quraanka ama xogta badan ee Qur'aanka. Sheegashada tarjumaada, sheegashooyinka mucjisooyinka sayniska, iyo warbixinada lagu muransan yahay kuma jiraan.
facts.structure.glanceSub: Tirooyinka qaabdhismeedka aasaasiga ah ee Quraanka, si toos ah uga akhri xogta badan ee Qur'aanka.
facts.structure.hierSub: Sida qoraalka loo qaybiyay. Heer kastaa waa halbeeg ka mid ah xogta qaabdhismeedka - ma aha halbeeg macne ah.
facts.structure.sajdahNote: Calaamadaha Sajdah waxa lagu duubay xogta badan ee isha. AskQuran wuxuu taxayaa tixraacyada kaliya mana ku sharaxo xukunkooda halkan.
facts.structure.muqattaatTitle: Suuradaha Ka Bilaabma Xarfaha Kala Tagsan
facts.structure.muqattaatNote: AskQuran waxa uu taxayaa qaabka qoraalka oo kaliya mana fasiro macnaha xarfahan.
facts.surahs.search: Ku raadi suuradda magaca ama nambarka…
facts.topics.title: Mawduucyada Quraanka lagu hagayo
facts.topics.sub: Mawduucyada hanuuninta nolosha oo si toos ah ugu xidhan aayadaha Quraanka. Guji tixraac kasta si aad u aragto Carabiga, tarjumaada, iyo tafsiirka halka laga heli karo.
facts.mentions.title: Quraanku wuu sheegay
facts.mentions.sub: Nabiyada iyo shakhsiyaadka muhiimka ah ee lagu magacaabay Quraanka, oo leh tixraacyo halka ay ku soo arooreen. Tirintu waa tirooyinka dhaca kelmada ee qoraalka Quraanka.
facts.mentions.punishmentSub: Dadka uu Quraanku ku sifeeyey in loo digay ama la ciqaabay, oo lagu kooxeeyey sababta qoraalka lagu sheegay. Loo taxay tixraac ahaan kaliya - xukunnada laguma sharraxin halkan.
facts.sources.title: Ilaha
facts.sources.sub: Xogta badan ee qaabdhismeedka ayaa laga akhriyay ilahan. Qur'aanka, tarjumaadda, iyo qoraalka tafsiirka ayaa had iyo jeer lagu muujiyaa hadal hadal ah oo sifo leh.
facts.sources.badge: Isha xogta badan ee qaab dhismeedka
facts.structure.sajdahDesc: Aayado Sajdah waxay ku taxan yihiin xogta badan ee Qur'aanka. Fur tixraac kasta si aad u aragto Carabi, tarjumaad, iyo tafsiir halka laga heli karo.
facts.structure.muqattaatDesc: Qaybtani waxa ay taxaysaa suurado ka bilaabma xarafyo is khilaafsan sida quraanka kariimka ah. Macnaha halkan laguma fasiro.
facts.surahs.sub: Dhammaan 114ka suuradood ee leh xog-ururin dhismeed. Ku raadi magaca ama nambarka, ku miir meesha muujinta, oo kala sooc.
facts.topics.trust: Mawduucyadan waxaa la soo bandhigay kaliya marka si toos ah loogu xidhi karo aayadaha Qur'aanka. Sheegashada fasiraadda iyo warbixinnada lagu muransan yahay waa laga saaray Xaqiiqooyinka Qur'aanka.
facts.mentions.intro: Magacyada, jaaliyadaha, kutubta, iyo meelaha lagu sheegay quraanka - mid walbaa wuxuu ku qotomaa inuu toosiyo tixraacyada aayadaha.
footer.freeEm: AskQuran waa bilaash, xayaysiisna ma laha, had iyo jeerna wuu ahaan doonaa.
footer.freeRest: Ma waydiiso deeqaha. Jawaabaheedu waxa ay ku salaysan yihiin oo keliya Qur'aanka kariimka ah, tarjumaad sax ah, iyo tafsiir, iyada oo aan lahayn qoraal diini ah oo la soo saaray.
footer.dua: Alle ha aqbalo dadaalkaas, hana ka dhigo mid anfaca, wixii dhaliil ahna ha dhaafo.
footer.src: Qoraalka xiga ee Tanzil · Turjumaada & tafsiirka waxaa lagu soo bandhigay iyadoo aan la bedelin
results.contextExplain: Aayadaha ku xeeran - wax yar ka hor iyo ka dib - ayaa la wada tusay si aayaddan loo akhriyo macnaheeda buuxda halkii ay keligeed ahaan lahayd.
results.tryMoreSpecific: Isku day su'aal aad u gaar ah.
about.h1: Quraanku waa hanuunka Eebe ee aadanaha, isagoo tusin hab cad oo lagu noolaado iimaan, caddaalad, naxariis iyo xisaabin.
about.lede: AskQuran waxa uu dadka ka caawiyaa in ay u gaadhaan hanuuninta Quraanka si cad, si toos ah, iyo macne sax ah - weligood jawaab la hindisay, had iyo jeer qoraalka isha.
about.whyLabel: Waa maxay sababta ay u jirto
about.whyP1: Waxay la hadlaysaa qalbiga, qoyska, bulshada, ganacsiga, caddaaladda, naxariista, la xisaabtanka, iyo xidhiidhka ka dhexeeya qofka iyo Alle. Waxay baraysaa dadka sida loo cibaadeysto, sida loola macaamilo dadka kale, sida loo ilaaliyo xuquuqda waalidka, lammaanaha, carruurta, qaraabada, agoonta, masaakiinta, iyo kuwa jilicsan - iyo sida loogu noolaado daacadnimo, dulqaad, sharaf iyo masuuliyad.
about.whyP2: Waxay ka bixinaysaa hanuun cad oo ku saabsan arrimo badan oo ay dadku kala kulmaan nolol maalmeedka: dhaxalka, guurka, furriinka, hantida, ganacsiga, deynta, sadaqada, dulmiga, cafiska, towbada, iyo dhaqanka shakhsi ahaaneed. Waxay u sheegaysaa sheekooyinka nebiyada iyo quruumihii hore - ma aha oo kaliya taariikhda, laakiin sida duruus ku saabsan caqiidada, kibirka, caddaalad darrada, musuqmaasuqa, anshaxa, iyo cawaaqibka doorashooyinka aadanaha.
about.beliefHi: dadku waa inay u gaadhaan hanuunka Quraanka si cad, toos ah, iyo macne habboon.
about.whatHead: Matoorka tixraaca ee Qur'aanka oo uu taageero
about.whatP1: Marka qof uu weydiiyo su'aal la xiriirta nolosha, AskQuran wuxuu baadhaa xogta Quraanka ee la hayo oo wuxuu soo celiyaa tixraacyada Qur'aanka ee khuseeya - oo wata aayad Carabi asalka ah, tarjumaad la doortay, ku hareeraysan macnaha aayaadka, iyo tafsiirka meesha la heli karo.
about.includesLabel: Jawaab kasta oo dadwayne waxaa ku jira
about.inc1s: Quraanka kariimka ah wuxuu ku qoran yahay Carabigiisii asalka ahaa
about.inc3s: Ka yimid turjumaan la magacaabay, la doortay
about.inc4s: Aayadaha isla markiiba hor iyo gadaalba
about.inc6s: Qoraal kasta oo la raad raaco asalkiisa
about.does1: Ka raadi xogta Quraanka ee la tilmaamay oo soo celi tixraacyada khuseeya
about.does2: Xigasho isha qoraalka si toos ah iyo macnaha guud
about.does3: Ka caawi dadka inay si cad u bartaan tuducyada khuseeya
about.does4: Si cad u dheh marka aan la helin tixraac cad oo sal ku leh
about.doesNot1: Samee ra'yi diineed, fatwooyin, ama tafsiir shaqsiyeed
about.doesNot3: Beddel tarjumaada ama tafsiirka si kastaba ha ahaatee
about.doesNot4: Abuur jawaab ama fidi ku habboonaanta si aad u buuxiso farqiga
about.sensitiveHead: Calaamadaha mawduuca waa lakabka hagidda - wax dheeraad ah ma jiraan
about.sensitiveP1: Mawduucyada xasaasiga ah sida dhaxalka, furriinka, xuquuqda haweenka, khilaafaadka qoyska, hantida, ama dhaqanka bulshada, AskQuran wuxuu isticmaalaa xogta badan ee mawduuca dib loo eegay si uu ugu xidho su'aalaha caadiga ah iyo tuducyada Qur'aanka ee khuseeya.
about.noteH3: Calaamadahani waa kaliya dariiqa loo maro
about.noteP: Ma aha kitaab Quraan ah, ma aha tafsiir, iyo xukun diimeed. Waa in dib loo eego ka hor inta aan si guud loo isticmaalin, waxaana si cad looga ilaaliyaa qoraalka isha tallaabo kasta.
about.commitHead: Afar shay ayaan had iyo jeer samayn doonaa
about.pledge1s: Isha aayadda waxa loo hayaa sidii loo soo dejiyey, lamana taaban.
about.pledge2s: Waxaa loo soo bandhigay sida ay u qoreen qoraayaashooda la magacaabay.
about.pledge3s: Qoraalka asalka ah iyo sumadaha mawduuca weligood ma wada dheeho.
about.pledge4s: Ma jiraan tixraac cad? Waxaan dhahnaa sidaas, halkii aan kala bixin lahayn.
about.purposeLead: In dadka laga caawiyo inay Qur'aanka ku soo laabtaan si ay u noqdaan kuwo wanaagsan
about.purposeHi: runta, caddaaladda, naxariista, iyo isla xisaabtanka.

facts.topic.inheritanceD: Tilmaanta Quraanka ee saamiga dhaxalka iyo xuquuqda qoyska.
facts.topic.fastingD: Hanuuninta Quraanka Soonka, Ramadaanka, Ka-dhaafitaanka, iyo axkaamta la xidhiidha.
facts.topic.divorceD: Tilmaanta Quraanka ee furriinka, muddada sugitaanka, caddaaladda, iyo masuuliyadda qoyska.
facts.topic.parentsD: Tilmaanta Quraanka ee naxariista, ixtiraamka, mahadnaqa, iyo xuduudaha waalidka.
facts.topic.justiceD: Waa hanuun Quraan ah oo ku saabsan u istaagida caddaaladda, xataa naftada ama kooxdeeda.
facts.topic.charityD: Tilmaanta Quraanka ee wax bixinta, nadiifinta maalka, u gargaarida masaakiinta, iyo masuuliyadda bulshada.
facts.source.tanzilMetaD: Magacyada suuradda, tirinta aayaadka, iyo qaybaha aasaasiga ah ee qoraalka Quraanka.
facts.source.tanzilOrderD: Qaabka soo jireenka ah ee soojireenka ah ee suuradaha.
facts.source.corpusD: Xogta Carabiga heerka Eray, qaab-dhismeedka, iyo tixraacyada aayadaha ee qoraalka Quraanka.
facts.source.qfD: Aayadda, tarjumaadda, iyo xogta badan ee tafsiir ee loo isticmaalay in lagu muujiyo waxa ka kooban sifo.
facts.dp.g.0.d: Bulshooyinka si isdaba joog ah ayaa loo muujiyaa diidmada fariimaha, diida digniinaha, ama diida xusuusinta cad.
facts.dp.i.0.0.s: Nuux way beeniyeen, wayna diideen digniintii.
facts.dp.i.0.1.s: Waxayna beeniyeen Rasuulladii loo soo diray, waxaana qabtay hal qarax.
facts.dp.i.0.2.s: Quraanku wuxuu sheegay inay ka mid yihiin qoomkii beeniyey rasuullada. Faahfaahinta laguma sii faafin Quraanka.
facts.dp.i.0.3.s: Quraanku wuxuu ku xusay Gaaladii Qoomkii hore ee beeniyey.
facts.dp.g.1.d: Quraanku wuxuu caddeeyey cadaab iyo beenin aayaadka Eebe iyo caasinimada Rasuullada ka dib markuu hanuunku caddeeyey.
facts.dp.i.1.0.s: Waxay beeniyeen aayaadkii Eebahood, wayna caasiyeen rusushiisii, waxayna raaceen daalimiintii is kibray.
facts.dp.i.1.1.s: Way beeniyeen Nabi Saalax, waxayna diideen calaamadii hasha, wayna xad gudbeen.
facts.dp.g.2.d: Quraanku wuxuu xusay bulshooyinka looga digay musuqmaasuqa, qishka, iyo duudsiga dadka xuquuqdooda.
facts.dp.i.2.0.s: Waxaa looga digay inaan la dhimin cabbirka iyo miisaanka, dadkana aan la duudsiin xaqooda, isla markaana aan la faafin fasaadka.
facts.dp.i.2.1.s: Waxay qorsheeyeen inay si gaar ah u goostaan ​​iyagoo masaakiinta ka celinaya, ka dibna beertoodii waa la baabi'iyay.
facts.dp.g.3.d: Quraanku wuxuu ku tusin ciqaabta xoogga dulmiga, isla waynida iyo diidmada aayaadka cad.
facts.dp.i.3.0.s: Way is-kibriyeen, waxayna beeniyeen Aayadaha, waxayna Dulmi jireen Banii Israa'iil, wayna dileen Wiilal, wayna nooleeyeen Haweenka.
facts.dp.i.3.1.s: Quraanku wuxuu yidhi Eebe wuu dhumay Dhagartooda.
facts.dp.g.4.t: Damiir xumo iyo xad gudubka furan
facts.dp.g.4.d: Quraanku waxa uu sheegay bulshooyinka la ciqaabay kadib xumaanta iyo xad gudubka cad.
facts.dp.i.4.0.s: Waxay ku kaceen xumaan cad, waxayna ula tageen rag hamigooda ka sokow dumarka.
facts.dp.g.5.d: Quraanku wuxuu sheegay in loo duceeyey oo ka jeedsaday.
facts.dp.i.5.0.s: Wayna jeedsadeen in la barakeeyey ka dib.
facts.dp.g.6.d: Quraanku waxa uu sheegay kooxaha la ciqaabay ka dib markay xad gudbeen amar iyagoo og.
facts.dp.i.6.0.s: Waxayna ku xadgudbeen sabtida intay imtixaan ka qaadeen.

facts.plants.title: Fruits, Trees and Plants in the Quran
facts.plants.sub: Quran references to named fruits, trees, and plant foods, shown only from direct ayah references.
facts.plants.sourceNote: This list is generated from direct Arabic term matches in the local Tanzil Quran text. It does not add botanical claims or tafsir-based identifications.
facts.plant.datesN: Some references mention the date-palm tree, its fruit, or date-palms in gardens.
facts.plant.olivesN: 24:35 mentions a blessed olive tree in the parable of light.
facts.plant.fruitGeneralN: These references use general fruit wording rather than a specific named fruit.
facts.plant.datePalmTreeN: This overlaps with dates because the Quran mentions date-palms as trees and in fruit/garden contexts.
facts.plant.talhN: Translations differ; some render it as layered banana, others as acacia or a thornless lote-like tree. No single botanical identification is forced.
facts.plant.khamtN: Often translated as bitter fruit/tree. The label is kept cautious.
facts.plant.treeGenericN: These references use general tree wording or specific Quranic tree contexts.
facts.plant.fumN: Translations differ; often rendered garlic, wheat, or grain. The label is kept cautious as “Fum”.
facts.plant.rayhanN: Often translated as basil, fragrant plant, or sweet-scented plant. The label is kept cautious.
